resources.string: Every app on this phone. Cloud fleet apps update here; any other app\'s origin button opens the store that installed it. Stop needs the paired adb channel; Remove asks Android to confirm.
Not published in the Cloud fleet yet, so there is nothing to update to.
This app has no launcher screen to open.
Force-stop needs the embedded adb channel. Pair Wireless Debugging (Store ▸ Cloud header) or use App info ▸ Force stop.
Stopping SuperApp would close this store.
A system app cannot be removed, only disabled from App info.
This build has no Cloud store page to open.
